t: This machine when combined with power and $(6)water$() (or $(6)lava$() for nether crops) it will speed up growth crop a bit. $(br2)By providing very small amounts of $(l:resource_production/ether_gas)Ether Gas$() crops will grow much faster and they will be replanted automatically.
当该机器获得能量与$(6)水$()（或下界作物所需的$(6)熔岩$()）时，可略微加快作物生长速度。$(br2)若额外注入极少量$(l:resource_production/ether_gas)以太气体$()，作物将大幅加速生长，并自动重新种植。
